stories.title: Thailand seeks its own path into the Bitcoin and Ethereum ETF market
stories.summary: Thailand wants access to the $120 billion Bitcoin and Ethereum ETF market. But the country wants to set its own terms, not simply copy existing frameworks from other markets. The report does not specify the exact rules Thailand plans to apply.
stories.whyItMatters: A major Asian market setting its own crypto ETF rules could shape how other countries balance access against local control.
whatToWatch: Details of Thailand's proposed ETF framework
questions: What specific terms does Thailand want to set?
Which regulator is leading this proposal?

sources.title: Thailand wants a piece of the $120 billion Bitcoin and Ethereum ETF market, but on its own terms

stories.title: Bitcoin's rebound nears $85,000, a level where past buyers may sell
stories.summary: Bitcoin's price is rebounding toward $85,000. Past buyers who entered near this level may choose to sell there, according to the report. This is a technical observation about price history, not a confirmed forecast.
stories.whyItMatters: The $85,000 zone could test whether the current rebound has enough strength to push through past-buyer selling.
whatToWatch: Whether Bitcoin breaks through or stalls at $85,000
questions: How much selling pressure actually sits at this level?

sources.title: Bitcoin’s rebound approaches the $85,000 zone where past buyers may sell

stories.title: France's tax proposal would hit Bitcoin-to-USDC swaps before cash-out
stories.summary: A French tax proposal would tax swaps from Bitcoin into USDC, a stablecoin, even before investors convert to fiat currency. This departs from taxing crypto gains only when investors cash out. The report does not give further detail on the proposal's scope or timeline.
stories.whyItMatters: Taxing crypto-to-stablecoin swaps as a taxable event could change how investors in France, and possibly elsewhere in the EU, manage their holdings.
whatToWatch: Progress of the proposal through the French legislature
Whether other EU countries consider similar rules
questions: When would this rule take effect?
Would it apply retroactively to past swaps?

sources.title: France’s tax proposal would tax Bitcoin-to-USDC swaps before investors cash out

stories.title: Eclair merges fixes for Lightning Network bugs that could burn Bitcoin in fees
stories.summary: Eclair, a Lightning Network implementation, merged code fixes for flaws that could cause users to lose Bitcoin to excessive transaction fees. The report does not state whether any funds were lost before the fix.
stories.whyItMatters: Lightning Network reliability matters for Bitcoin's use as a fast, low-cost payment layer.
whatToWatch: Adoption of the fix by other Lightning implementations
Eclair's release notes for the patched version
questions: Did any users lose funds before this fix?

sources.title: Eclair merges fixes for Lightning flaws that could burn Bitcoin in fees

stories.title: EU moves to close MiCA loophole on single-license crypto licensing
stories.summary: EU regulators are targeting a gap in the MiCA crypto rules that lets an exchange get one license in a single member state and use it to serve all 27 EU countries. The report does not name the specific jurisdictions or exchanges involved.
stories.whyItMatters: Closing this loophole could raise compliance costs and change where crypto exchanges choose to base their EU operations.
whatToWatch: Formal proposals to amend MiCA licensing rules
Reaction from exchanges that use single-license passporting
questions: Which jurisdictions are seen as license-shopping havens?
What would a fix require exchanges to change?

sources.title: EU targets MiCA loophole that lets crypto exchanges serve 27 countries with one license

stories.title: Solana wallet tested a fake address with $10, then lost $30,750
stories.summary: A Solana wallet sent a small $10 test transfer to an address before sending a much larger amount. The address turned out to be fake, and the wallet lost $30,750 in the full transfer.
stories.whyItMatters: The case is a reminder that address-poisoning and look-alike address scams remain a real risk for crypto users, even cautious ones.
whatToWatch: Further reports of similar scams on Solana
questions: Who is behind the fake address?
Can wallet software better flag this pattern?

sources.title: A Solana wallet tested a fake address with $10, then sent it $30,750

stories.title: Cryptomus rebrand to Heleket keeps the same UK sanctions target
stories.summary: Payment processor Cryptomus has rebranded as Heleket. The report states this does not change the underlying entity that the UK has placed under sanctions.
stories.whyItMatters: A rebrand that does not escape sanctions matters for anyone tracking how sanctioned crypto entities try to keep operating.
whatToWatch: Whether UK authorities update sanctions listings to name Heleket
Further rebrand attempts by the same entity
questions: Will UK sanctions enforcement explicitly cover the new name?

sources.title: Switching from Cryptomus to Heleket leaves the same UK sanctions target

stories.title: Solana sandwich bots extracted $29.7 million, mostly from Pump.fun trades
stories.summary: Automated sandwich bots on Solana extracted $29.7 million before costs. Most of this came from trades on Pump.fun, a popular memecoin trading platform. The report does not state net profit after costs or the time period covered.
stories.whyItMatters: This shows MEV extraction continues to drain value from retail traders on Solana, especially memecoin buyers on Pump.fun.
whatToWatch: Any mitigation steps from Solana validators or Pump.fun
Updated figures on sandwich bot activity
questions: Over what time period was this $29.7 million measured?
What is the net profit after bot operating costs?

sources.title: Solana sandwich bots took $29.7 million before costs, mostly targeting Pump.fun

stories.title: XRP rebounds as Binance spot trading volume drops nearly 80%
stories.summary: XRP's price rebounded even as spot trading turnover on Binance fell by close to 80%. The report does not explain the cause of the volume drop.
stories.whyItMatters: A price rebound on much lower trading volume can signal weaker conviction behind the move, which matters for anyone assessing the rally's durability.
whatToWatch: Whether Binance spot volume for XRP recovers
Whether the price rebound holds without volume support
questions: What caused the sharp drop in spot turnover?

sources.title: XRP rebounded as Binance spot turnover fell nearly 80%

stories.title: Ledger wallet implant reveals a gap in its authenticity check
stories.summary: A hardware implant found in a Ledger wallet exposed a weakness in the device's method for verifying that it is genuine. The report does not state how many devices are affected or whether Ledger has issued a fix.
stories.whyItMatters: Hardware wallets are a core defense for storing crypto safely, so a gap in authenticity checks threatens that trust.
whatToWatch: Ledger's response and any security patch
Guidance on buying devices only from verified sources
questions: How many devices carry this vulnerability?
Has Ledger issued a fix yet?

sources.title: Ledger wallet implant exposes a gap in its authenticity check
